svg.aria-label: Detachable tent harness and gap junction
svg.text: Detachable tent harness and gap junction
Four keyed connectors at the cab–tub gap. Unplug J1–J4, cap them, and the tent lifts off with its harness and services box.
Detachable tent harness and gap junction
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.11.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
LEGEND · line weight ∝ conductor size · ID · size tags = cable schedule IDs · purple ▶◀ = detachable connector · yellow flags = continues on another sheet
under the tent, front, inset · stays with the tent
DO4 Starlink 4 mm² twin · pass-through gland (not detachable)
PVR roof PV 6 mm² solar twin · pass-through gland (not detachable)
J1 · 230 V OUT TO TENT · IP66 10 A (CLIPSAL 56 SERIES)
J2 · 230 V SHORE IN · IP66 15 A INLET + EXTENSION SOCKET
1. Switch the inverter off (S2) and isolate shore power at the source.
2. Unplug J2 (shore in) first, then J1, J3, J4.
3. Fit the caps to all eight halves (IP66 caps / SB50 dust covers).
4. Unclip the harness from the lid-front saddles, then lift the tent.
Refit in reverse. SB50 colours are keyed: red and grey won't mate,
and J1/J2 differ in rating and gender, so nothing can cross-connect.
